ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Company Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to 6 months at HDI's then-current rates; (b) within 30 days after expiration or termination, return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other Company data in HDI's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content, information and data from its systems and certify such deletion to the Company in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no exit mechanic, so we are adding Section 4.3: up to 6 months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiration or termination, and deletion with written certification thereafter. This is our preferred transition position; we can discuss a 90-day assistance period, but need the 30-day return.
input.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return/deletion clause in Section 4
